style_reference.shared_prompt: Original bold mid-century horror-cartoon colouring-book ink art for adults: clean white paper, thick varied black contours, rounded expressive shape language and crisp closed colourable forms. Medium-detail retro graphic styling with roomy open areas, selective simple patterning, controlled spot-black shadows and sparse screen-print-like texture marks. Playful, nostalgic and lightly macabre mood; no colour, gradients, hatching, grey wash, fine-line rendering or realistic shading. High-contrast, home-printable monochrome line work.
style_reference.line_weight: Thick to very thick black outlines, with deliberate weight variation for emphasis; never fine line.
style_reference.line_quality: Smooth, confident, rounded ink contours with slightly bouncy hand-drawn energy; crisp closed shapes for easy colouring.
style_reference.detail_level: Medium detail: large, satisfying colourable shapes supported by selective decorative accents, simple patterns and readable background props; avoid dense micro-detail.
style_reference.shading: No realistic rendering, gradients or hatching. Use occasional solid black shadow masses, simple spot blacks and sparse graphic texture marks only where they strengthen contrast.
style_reference.background_density: Moderately populated scene dressing that frames the main action without filling every gap; preserve generous white areas and clear colour zones.

canvas.format_notes: Single-sided portrait colouring pages with generous colourable spaces, robust contours and practical breathing room for A4 and US Letter home printing.

pages.title: See You at Midnight
pages.scene: A final celebratory diner tableau and friendly end page.
pages.composition: The diner façade is seen front-on beneath a huge crescent moon, with the main monster cast waving from windows and doorway: vampire, mummy, witch, cyclops, werewolf and ghost. A large haunted milkshake sits on the roof like a sign topper. Six simple stars, two pumpkins and a blank banner provide a celebratory finale.
pages.subject: Finale colouring page titled “SEE YOU AT MIDNIGHT”: front-on retro diner facade beneath huge crescent moon; vampire, mummy, witch, cyclops, werewolf and ghost waving from windows and doorway; giant haunted milkshake roof topper; exactly six stars, two pumpkins and a blank celebratory banner.
